specs.Compatible Devices: Computers, Smartphones, Tablets with USB-C ports or Wi-Fi capabilities
specs.Camera Lens: 125x Optical Zoom Telephoto Lens with Dual Detect Optical VR Image Stabilization

features: 125x Optical Zoom. Ultra-telephoto reach equivalent to 24-3000mm with a 250X Dynamic Fine Zoom
Rock Steady. Dual Detect Optical VR image stabilization, equivalent to shooting at a shutter speed 4.0 stops.

Power-packed Point-and-shoot. Cover an extraordinary range of shots—ultra-telephoto, wide-angle, and even macro close-ups—as JPEG or .NRW (RAW) photos, 4K UHD video, smooth slow-motion, time-lapse and Super lapse movies.

Easy Access Bird-watching Mode. Selectable right from the mode dial, it optimizes camera settings for capturing. Close Focus Macro Mode. The Macro focus mode lets you get as close as approx. 1 cm from your subject to reveal the smallest details in brilliant clarity.
Customizable Control Ring. Use it for manual focus or for adjusting exposure compensation, white balance
description: Reach for the stars with this power-packed mega-zoom. Its mind-blowing 125x optical zoom lens can bring the universe within reach—from the craters and mountains of the Moon to immersive landscapes, portraits with blurred backgrounds and even macro-style closeups. Dual Detect Optical VR image stabilization keeps photos sharp and 4K Ultra HD videos steady, while easy-to-use Scene modes ensure great results. Whether exploring the night sky,chasing amazing views of birds, or revealing the tiny details of nature, the COOLPIX P1100 has you covered
